intent_en: Compare how civil wars ended before 1989 versus now, and determine the shift between endings by military force and by negotiated settlement.
narration_support: Victory for one side in a civil war was common, while nowadays, victories are much rarer. At the same time, negotiated endings have jumped from 10 % to almost 40%.
narrative_goal: Show the shift in civil-war endings from military force toward negotiated settlements.
current_model_input: Compare how civil wars ended before 1989 versus now, and determine the shift between endings by military force and by negotiated settlement.
